name: Culler de Pau

menus.name: Descuberta menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; the longest and most inventive: four snacks, 13 to 15 dishes, a pre-dessert and two desserts; about three and a half hours; served from 1.30 to 2pm at lunch and until 9pm at dinner

menus.name: Marexada menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; four snacks, seven dishes, a pre-dessert and two desserts; about two and a half hours; can be made vegetarian

menus.name: Ronsel menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; the shortest, with the most classic dishes: five snacks, four dishes and two desserts; about an hour and a half; can be made vegetarian or vegan

bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's website (TheFork), or by email or phone. Every booking is guaranteed with a credit card, and a confirmation comes by email or SMS.
cancellation: Cancel in writing at least 24 hours ahead, with the restaurant's confirmation; later cancellations are charged under the cancellation policy taken on the card.
walkIns: Booking is recommended as space is limited; for last-minute cancellations, phone or email.
dressCode: No strict dress code; just no beachwear.
children: Children are welcome, though there's no play area; a children's menu for under-12s (starter, main and dessert) costs €75. High chairs on request.
duration: About three and a half hours for Descuberta, two and a half for Marexada and an hour and a half for Ronsel.
